fields.name: Length of NAS message container contents
NAS message container contents
fields.description: NAS message container contents (octet 4 to octet n); Max value of 65535 octets. This IE can contain a REGISTRATION REQUEST message as defined in subclause 5.5.1, or a SERVICE REQUEST message as defined in subclause 5.6.1, or non-cleartext IEs of a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message as defined in subclause 5.6.1.
